source_refs.model_visible_text: On Gmail on a computer: Open the email you want to stop receiving. Next to the sender's name, click 'Unsubscribe'. In the pop-up, click 'Unsubscribe' or 'Go to website'. Some senders require you to unsubscribe on their website. In that case, the email shows a 'Go to website' option instead of an unsubscribe option. Unsubscribing from one email may remove you from only one of the sender's mailing lists. To find all of a sender's subscriptions, click 'More', then 'Manage subscriptions' on the left. After you unsubscribe, it may take a few days for you to stop receiving emails from the mailing list.

source_refs.model_visible_text: On Gmail on a computer: On your computer, open Gmail. Review the sender's messages before unsubscribing. In the left menu, click 'More', then 'Manage subscriptions'. On the right, next to the number of recent emails from that sender, click 'Unsubscribe'. Gmail unsubscribes you from all active mailing lists related to the sender. The sender may take a few days to process the request, so you may still receive emails during that time. New emails from the unsubscribed sender go to Spam, with a banner explaining why. Some senders send you to their website. If a pop-up appears, click 'Go to website' to unsubscribe there, or 'Block instead' to block the sender. Blocking a sender does not unsubscribe you from their mailing list. Their future emails go directly to Spam. The ability to manage email subscriptions is gradually rolling out and may not be available to you yet.
